Wait! Let's check:
Is it possible that the API call in `fetchDocDetails()` takes some time to load, and during this time, `isEditMode` is already `true`?
Yes, `isEditMode` is `true`.
Wait! If they edit fields *before* the API call completes, or *after*?
Normally they edit *after* it completes.
Wait! Let's check `isEditMode` value:
`const isEditMode = id && id !== 'new';`
Is `id` matching?
Yes!
But wait! Let's look at the screenshot again:
The screenshot has:
`LỊCH SỬ SỬA ĐỔI / REVISION LOGS`
`LẦN H/C | NGÀY SỬA | NỘI DUNG SỬA ĐỔI | TRANG SỐ | NGƯỜI SỬA | THAO TÁC`
`1 | VD: 13/07/2026 | Ban hành lần đầu | Tất cả | [Người sửa...] | Xóa`
Wait, does it show the second row?
No!
Why did the second row not get added when they edited?
Let's look at the console logs or let's debug `handleInputChange`.
Wait! When they type in the input:
```javascript
  const handleInputChange = (field, val) => {
    setFormData(prev => {
      let updatedLogs = prev.revision_logs || [];
      if (isEditMode && !hasAddedAutoLog.current) {
        hasAddedAutoLog.current = true;
        const newLog = {
          rev_date: getCurrentFormattedDate(),
          content: 'Hiệu chỉnh thông tin mẫu ISO',
          page_no: 'Tất cả',
          modifier: loggedInUser.full_name || ''
        };
        updatedLogs = [...updatedLogs, newLog];
      }
      return {
        ...prev,
        [field]: val,
        revision_logs: updatedLogs
      };
    });
  };
```
Wait! Look at `updatedLogs = [...updatedLogs, newLog]`.
If `prev.revision_logs` was initially loaded from `fetchDocDetails`, then `prev.revision_logs` has the item: `[{ seq_no: 1, rev_date: '', content: 'Ban hành lần đầu', page_no: 'Tất cả' }]`.
Then `updatedLogs` becomes:
`[{ seq_no: 1, rev_date: '', content: 'Ban hành lần đầu', page_no: 'Tất cả' }, { rev_date: '13/07/2026', content: 'Hiệu chỉnh thông tin mẫu ISO', page_no: 'Tất cả', modifier: '...' }]`.
And this is returned in the new state.
But wait! Is the component rendering this new state?
Yes! The component renders `formData.revision_logs`.
But wait! Why is the second row not appearing?
Wait... is it possible that `hasAddedAutoLog.current` was set to `true` during the initial rendering or loading?
Let's check:
Ah!
When the component first renders, `fetchDocDetails` runs:
```javascript
  const fetchDocDetails = async () => {
    ...
      setFormData({
        ...
      });
```
Wait! Setting the state of `formData` in `fetchDocDetails` does NOT call `handleInputChange`.
But wait! Is there any other place where `setFormData` or `handleInputChange` is called?
Wait! Let's check `useEffect` around lines 75 to 105:
```javascript
  useEffect(() => {
    if (location.state?.parsedData) {
      const parsed = location.state.parsedData;
      ...
        setFormData(prev => ({
          ...prev,
          code: nextCode,
          symbol: isGenericSymbol ? '' : parsedSymbol,
          name: isGenericName ? '' : parsedName,
          version: parsed.version || '01',
          issue_date: getCurrentFormattedDate(),
          file_path: parsed.file_path || '',
          status: 'Nháp',
          folder: parsed.folder || '',
          doc_type: parsed.doc_type || '',
          document_level: parsed.document_level || '',
          notes: parsed.notes || '',
          sections: newSections,
          section_types: newSectionTypes
        }));
```
Wait! If they are editing, and they did NOT upload a file, then `location.state?.parsedData` is `null`. So it falls into:
```javascript
    } else if (isEditMode) {
      fetchDocDetails();
    }
```
Which is correct!
Wait, but what if they *do* edit the document, but `hasAddedAutoLog.current` was somehow already set to `true`?
No, it's a ref initialized to `false`. It is only set to `true` when:
1. `handleInputChange` runs in `isEditMode`.
2. `onChange` of section format types runs in `isEditMode`.
So it should definitely be `false` when they type the first character!
Wait! Let's test this in our own mind.
If they typed `aa5`, they edited `name`.
If `handleInputChange` ran, it should have set `hasAddedAutoLog.current = true` and added the log.
Wait, did the state actually update and did they see it?
What if they did NOT see it, because of a React batching state update issue?
No, `useRef` is mutable immediately, so `hasAddedAutoLog.current = true` is set immediately.
Wait, let's think: is it possible that `isEditMode` was `false` because `id` was undefined/null?
No, the path is `/admin/iso-documents/edit/:id`. When editing, `:id` is a route parameter, so `id` from `useParams()` is `'13'`, which is a truthy string and not equal to `'new'`. So `isEditMode` is `true`.

Wait! Let's look at the database row again!
`ID: 182, DocID: 13, Seq: 1, Date: , Content: Ban hành lần đầu, Page: Tất cả, Modifier: `
Wait! If they clicked "Save", it deletes all revision logs:
`db.query(ISORevisionLog).filter(ISORevisionLog.document_id == doc.id).delete()`
Then it adds the new revision logs.
Since the database ONLY has one log (with `Seq: 1`), it means that the client sent a payload containing ONLY ONE log row!
Why did the client send a payload with only one log row?
Let's see: `finalPayload` gets `revision_logs` from `formData.revision_logs`.
If `formData.revision_logs` only had 1 row, then `finalPayload` would only have 1 row!
Why would `formData.revision_logs` only have 1 row when they click "Save"?
Wait! Let's look at `ISOFormEditorView.jsx` lines 145 to 175:
```javascript
      setFormData({
        id: data.id,
        code: data.code || '',
        name: data.name || '',
        symbol: data.symbol || '',
        version: data.version || '01',
        issue_date: stripTime(data.issue_date || getCurrentFormattedDate()),
        issuer: loggedInUser.full_name || data.issuer || '',
        approver: data.approver || '',
        file_path: data.file_path || '',
        status: data.status || 'Đang lưu hành',
        folder: data.folder || data.display_at || '',
        doc_type: data.doc_type || data.notes || '',
        document_level: data.document_level || '',
        notes: data.notes || '',
        revision_logs: data.revision_logs || [],
        sections: receivedSections,
        section_types: sectionTypes,
        steps: data.steps || []
      });
```
Wait! Look at this!
In `fetchDocDetails`, they fetch data.
But wait! If they open the page, they edit it, and they save it.
Wait! When they type in the "Tên tài liệu" input, does `handleInputChange` get called?
Yes!
But wait, why was `hasAddedAutoLog.current` not true?
Let's check if the ref `hasAddedAutoLog` is defined outside or inside the component?
It is defined inside `ISOFormEditorView` component:
```javascript
const ISOFormEditorView = () => {
  ...
  const hasAddedAutoLog = useRef(false);
```
So it persists across re-renders. That is correct.
Wait, let's think: what if `handleInputChange` is NOT called for some reason?
Let's check if there are other fields they edited.
"tôi đã chỉnh sửa nhìu lần sao lại k có lịch sử nào"
Wait! Did they modify the "Tên tài liệu"?
Yes, the name in the database changed from `aa` to `aa5`.
But wait! Did they edit it by typing, or did they edit it by uploading a Word document?
Ah!!!
"tôi đã chỉnh sửa nhìu lần sao lại k có lịch sử nào"
If they edit it by uploading a Word document, they click the upload button, select a file, and it parses the file.
When they parse the file, it calls:
```javascript
      setFormData(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        code: nextCode,
        symbol: isGenericSymbol ? '' : parsedSymbol,
        name: isGenericName ? '' : parsedName,
        version: parsed.version || '01',
        file_path: parsed.file_path || '',
        status: 'Nháp',
        folder: parsed.folder || '',
        doc_type: parsed.doc_type || '',
        document_level: parsed.document_level || '',
        notes: parsed.notes || '',
        sections: newSections,
        section_types: newSectionTypes
      }));
```
Wait! This `setFormData` call does NOT trigger `handleInputChange`!
Because it sets the state directly inside the `useEffect` block!
So if they edit by importing a Word file, `handleInputChange` is NEVER called, and thus the automatic log is NEVER appended!
And since they just click "Lưu" directly after parsing, `formData.revision_logs` remains unchanged (only has the initial 1 row)!
This is a massive realization!
If they import/upload a Word file, it updates the document fields, but it bypasses `handleInputChange`.
Wait, is there another way to automatically append the revision log on Save?
Yes! Why don't we check and append the revision log row **at the moment they click "Save" (Lưu)**, rather than dynamically as they type?
If we do it on Save, it is 100% reliable, regardless of whether they typed in the fields, imported a Word file, or made any other changes!
Let's think: how would that work?
When the user clicks "Save":
- If they are in Edit Mode:
  - We can check if `hasAddedAutoLog.current` is true, OR we can check if they have already added a log today.
  - Or even simpler: we can check if the current `formData` is different from the original data loaded from the database!
  - Wait, how do we know if it's different? We can store the original data in a ref `originalData.current` when it loads.
  - When they click "Lưu", we compare `formData` and `originalData.current`.
  - If they are different (meaning they actually edited something!), we automatically append a new revision log row:
    - `rev_date`: `getCurrentFormattedDate()`
    - `content`: 'Cập nhật tài liệu' (or let them enter it, or default to a description based on what they edited, e.g. "Cập nhật tài liệu qua tệp Word" if they imported a file, otherwise "Cập nhật thông tin tài liệu").
    - `page_no`: 'Tất cả'
    - `modifier`: `loggedInUser.full_name || ''`
  - And then we send the payload!
This is incredibly robust, elegant, and 100% guarantees that a new revision log row is added whenever they edit and save!
Let's think: is this much better?
Yes, it is infinitely better and completely foolproof! It handles:
- Importing a Word file
- Keystrokes in inputs
- Changing section format types
- Any other updates

Let's design this!
1. We declare a ref to store original data:
```javascript
  const originalDataRef = useRef(null);
```
2. When we load details in `fetchDocDetails`:
```javascript
      const loadedData = {
        id: data.id,
        code: data.code || '',
        name: data.name || '',
        symbol: data.symbol || '',
        version: data.version || '01',
        issue_date: stripTime(data.issue_date || getCurrentFormattedDate()),
        issuer: loggedInUser.full_name || data.issuer || '',
        approver: data.approver || '',
        file_path: data.file_path || '',
        status: data.status || 'Đang lưu hành',
        folder: data.folder || data.display_at || '',
        doc_type: data.doc_type || data.notes || '',
        document_level: data.document_level || '',
        notes: data.notes || '',
        revision_logs: data.revision_logs || [],
        sections: receivedSections,
        section_types: sectionTypes,
        steps: data.steps || []
      };
      setFormData(loadedData);
      originalDataRef.current = loadedData;
```
3. In the parsed generic file `useEffect`:
Wait! If they parsed a file, they definitely edited the document (since importing a file changes the contents).
So we can track if they imported a file using a ref or state `hasImportedFile.current = true`.
```javascript
  const hasImportedFile = useRef(false);
```
Inside the import `useEffect` block, we set `hasImportedFile.current = true`.

4. When they click "Lưu" (in `handleSaveForm`):
```javascript
  const handleSaveForm = async () => {
    if (!formData.code) {
      showFeedback('error', 'Mã mẫu không được để trống');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const now = new Date();
      const pad = (num) => String(num).padStart(2, '0');
      const hh = pad(now.getHours());
      const mm = pad(now.getMinutes());
      const finalIssueDate = `${hh}:${mm} ${stripTime(formData.issue_date || getCurrentFormattedDate())}`;

      let logs = [...(formData.revision_logs || [])];

      // Auto-append log on save if in edit mode and there are changes
      if (isEditMode) {
        const hasGeneralChanges = originalDataRef.current && (
          formData.code !== originalDataRef.current.code ||
          formData.name !== originalDataRef.current.name ||
          formData.symbol !== originalDataRef.current.symbol ||
          formData.version !== originalDataRef.current.version ||
          formData.notes !== originalDataRef.current.notes ||
          formData.document_level !== originalDataRef.current.document_level ||
          formData.folder !== originalDataRef.current.folder ||
          formData.doc_type !== originalDataRef.current.doc_type ||
          JSON.stringify(formData.section_types) !== JSON.stringify(originalDataRef.current.section_types)
        );
        const hasImported = hasImportedFile.current;

        if (hasGeneralChanges || hasImported) {
          // Check if we already appended a log for this save session
          // We can check if the last log entry is exactly a default auto-log today by the same user to avoid duplicate rows on consecutive saves
          const lastLog = logs[logs.length - 1];
          const todayStr = getCurrentFormattedDate();
          const isDuplicate = lastLog && 
                              lastLog.rev_date === todayStr && 
                              lastLog.modifier === (loggedInUser.full_name || '') &&
                              (lastLog.content === 'Cập nhật tài liệu' || lastLog.content === 'Cập nhật cấu trúc tài liệu qua Word');

          if (!isDuplicate) {
            const autoContent = hasImported ? 'Cập nhật cấu trúc tài liệu qua Word' : 'Cập nhật tài liệu';
            logs.push({
              rev_date: todayStr,
              content: autoContent,
              page_no: 'Tất cả',
              modifier: loggedInUser.full_name || ''
            });
          }
        }
      }

      const finalPayload = {
        ...formData,
        issue_date: finalIssueDate,
        name: formData.name || formData.code,
        display_at: formData.folder,
        notes: formData.doc_type,
        revision_logs: logs.map((log, index) => ({
          ...log,
          seq_no: index + 1
        })),
        sections: {
          ...(formData.sections || {}),
          '__metadata_section_types__': JSON.stringify(formData.section_types || {})
        }
      };
```
Oh my god!!!
This is absolutely perfect!
Let's analyze why this is so amazing:
1. It is completely automatic. The user doesn't have to manually press "+ Thêm dòng nhật ký".
2. It detects if there are *actually* changes to the general metadata fields or if a Word file was parsed and imported.
3. It prevents duplicate log entries if they save multiple times on the same day without closing (by checking if the last entry is an auto-log with today's date and the same user).
4. It sets the `rev_date` to today's date, `content` to "Cập nhật tài liệu" or "Cập nhật cấu trúc tài liệu qua Word", `page_no` to "Tất cả", and `modifier` to the logged-in user name!
5. The list of logs is correctly serialized and sent to the server.
6. The user can still click "+ Thêm dòng nhật ký" to add manual logs if they want to describe specific changes!

Wait, what if they only edit the sections?
Wait, as we checked earlier, in `ISOFormEditorView.jsx` (which is the Template editor), they config the section types but don't edit the section contents themselves (the contents are parsed from the uploaded Word file). If they upload a Word file, `hasImportedFile.current` becomes `true`, which correctly triggers the log!
So this covers 100% of all possible edit scenarios on this page!

Let's clean up `ISOFormEditorView.jsx`.
Let's see: we should:
- Keep the `Lịch sử sửa đổi` card UI as is (so they can see the history, delete rows, or manually add rows if they wish).
- Remove the inline autolog logic from `handleInputChange` and `onChange` of section types to avoid duplicate additions during typing (since we now do it cleanly at the save moment!).
This is a much cleaner separation of concerns: typing is smooth, and when they save, the system silently and correctly adds the log entry if there were changes!

Let's check where `originalDataRef` and `hasImportedFile` refs should be defined:
```javascript
  const originalDataRef = useRef(null);
  const hasImportedFile = useRef(false);
```
Let's put them at the top of `ISOFormEditorView` (around line 30).
Let's see what is currently at lines 28 to 36 of `ISOFormEditorView.jsx`:
```javascript
  const isProcessMode = false;
  const backPath = '/admin/iso-documents';
  const isEditMode = id && id !== 'new';
  const loggedInUser = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('smartflow_user') || '{}');
  const hasAddedAutoLog = useRef(false);

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
```
We'll replace `hasAddedAutoLog` with `originalDataRef` and `hasImportedFile`.

Let's trace the generic document parse `useEffect` (lines 75 to 110):
```javascript
        if (isGenericSymbol) {
          setSymbolPlaceholder(parsedSymbol);
        }
        if (isGenericName) {
          setNamePlaceholder(parsedName);
        }

        setFormData(prev => ({
          ...prev,
          code: nextCode,
          symbol: isGenericSymbol ? '' : parsedSymbol,
          name: isGenericName ? '' : parsedName,
          version: parsed.version || '01',
          issue_date: getCurrentFormattedDate(),
          file_path: parsed.file_path || '',
          status: 'Nháp',
          folder: parsed.folder || '',
          doc_type: parsed.doc_type || '',
          document_level: parsed.document_level || '',
          notes: parsed.notes || '',
          sections: newSections,
          section_types: newSectionTypes
        }));
      });
      showFeedback('success', 'Đã bóc tách tự động cấu trúc từ tài liệu Word thành công!');
```
We'll add `hasImportedFile.current = true;` inside this block.

Let's modify `ISOFormEditorView.jsx` using `multi_replace_file_content` with all these changes. Aberration: let's proceed.

args.Description: Implement clean and robust automatic revision logging upon saving edited ISO documents in ISOFormEditorView.jsx.
args.Instruction: Replace hasAddedAutoLog with originalDataRef and hasImportedFile refs. Set hasImportedFile to true when parsing Word files. Update fetchDocDetails to store originalDataRef. Revert handleInputChange and section type onChange back to clean handlers, and append the revision log row during handleSaveForm if changes are detected.

<select
                          value={currentType}
                          onChange={(e) => {
                            const type = e.target.value;
                            setFormData(prev => {
                              let updatedLogs = prev.revision_logs || [];
                              if (isEditMode && !hasAddedAutoLog.current) {
                                hasAddedAutoLog.current = true;
                                const newLog = {
                                  rev_date: getCurrentFormattedDate(),
                                  content: 'Hiệu chỉnh cấu hình định dạng đề mục',
                                  page_no: 'Tất cả',
                                  modifier: loggedInUser.full_name || ''
                                };

                              }
                              return {
                                ...prev,

                              };
                            });
                          }}
